description: This file contains PHP code for rendering a template that displays information about a 'call' associated with a project, including details like status, location, amount, associated sphere, and application links, within a dashboard or project application interface.

methods.name: call->getTagmark()
methods.description: Retrieves the tag mark associated with the call.

methods.name: call->getConf()
methods.description: Fetches configuration values related to the call, such as 'date_stage1_out' and 'max_projects'.

methods.name: call->getMainSphere()
methods.description: Returns the main sphere object related to the call, with a 'name' property.

methods.name: call->getPublished()
methods.description: Returns the number of published projects linked to the call.

methods.name: call->getSuccessPorcentage()
methods.description: Returns the success percentage of the call.
